title: Weak Serre closure of finite etale-local models in the actual coefficient encoding
statement: Let X be any scheme and B a finite commutative ring. Let R be a sheaf of commutative rings on the small pro-etale site of X and let φ identify the constant ring sheaf of the universe lift of B with R. Write R₀ for its underlying ring sheaf, and fix an etale chart V of X [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. For a sheaf F of R₀-modules let P(F) mean: for every etale W and map W -> V there is an etale covering sieve S of W such that for each Z -> W in S, F restricted to the concrete pro-etale slice over Z is isomorphic to the restriction of the ordinary scalar extension along φ of the lifted constant module sheaf of some finite B-module N [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Suppose the constant quotient realization functor preserves zero morphisms. Then the object property P in the ambient abelian category of R₀-module sheaves is closed under kernels and cokernels of maps between its objects and under short exact extensions. These are exactly ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderKernels, IsClosedUnderCokernels and IsClosedUnderExtensions, not closure under arbitrary subobjects.

proof.text: Use the existing exact fixed-scalar chart restriction H=finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction, followed by the inverse of proEtaleModuleEncoding on V.left, to construct an explicit additive exact functor E into intrinsic constant B-modules. The new finiteCoefficient_etaleLocal_encoding compares P(F) with fixedModels(H(F)). The public intrinsic_fixedModels comparison and the counit of proEtaleModuleEncoding then identify P(F) with finitely presented pro-etale local models of E(F).

A finite ring is Noetherian (Mathlib isNoetherian_of_finite). Apply proEtale_fp_localModels_serre to E(f) for every ambient morphism f whose endpoints satisfy P. Use the canonical PreservesKernel.iso and PreservesCokernel.iso, and invariance of intrinsic local models under isomorphism, to conclude P(kernel f) and P(cokernel f). For a short exact ambient complex, exactness of E gives a short exact mapped complex; the extension clause of the same theorem gives P of its middle object.

An arbitrary kernel fork or cokernel cofork in the ObjectProperty closure definitions is canonically isomorphic to the chosen kernel or cokernel. Transport the preceding conclusions along the unique limit or colimit comparison. This supplies exactly IsClosedUnderKernels and IsClosedUnderCokernels; the mapped short exact complex supplies IsClosedUnderExtensions.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoefficient_etaleLocal_weakSerre
    (X : Scheme.{t}) (B : Type t) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    [(koszulConstantFunctor X B).PreservesZeroMorphisms]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (φ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hφ : IsIso φ) (V : X.Etale) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R
    let P : ObjectProperty (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} R₀) := fun F ↦
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (_g : W ⟶ V),
        ∃ S : Sieve W, S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), S f →
            ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t} B, Module.Finite B N ∧ Nonempty
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj F ≅
                (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((completedAdicChange X (φ)).obj
                    ((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                      ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                        (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom ⋙
                      koszulConstantFunctor X B).obj N)))
    P.IsClosedUnderKernels ∧ P.IsClosedUnderCokernels ∧ P.IsClosedUnderExtensions
